name: Boxty
desc: A Fermanagh potato pancake of grated raw and mashed potato, cooked on the griddle. Restores 100 HP. Boxty on the griddle, boxty in the pan.

name: Fermanagh Black Bacon
desc: Slow dry-cured bacon from County Fermanagh with a dark, almost black rind. Restores 170 HP. Fry it slowly, out of respect.

name: Smoked Lough Neagh Eel
desc: Wild eel from Lough Neagh, protected by an EU geographical indication since 2011, smoked over hardwood. Restores 150 HP. Rich, smoky and very slightly judgemental.

name: Armagh Bramley
desc: A sharp green cooking apple from the Orchard County, with protected status since 2012. Restores 45 HP. Better in a tart, but needs must.

name: Illuminated Page
desc: A vellum page painted by a monk of Devenish, all birds and knotwork and real gold leaf. Mostly real.

name: Geopark Pin
desc: A badge for friends of the Marble Arch Caves UNESCO Global Geopark. Solid as the limestone under Cuilcagh.
msg: {name}'s Geopark Pin took the edge off the blow!

name: Scutched Flax
desc: Long, soft, pale-gold flax fibre beaten clean in a scutch mill. Spin it and weave it and you have Irish linen, eventually.
